title: iva xanthiifolia var. pedicellata
intro: Iva xanthiifolia var. pedicellata, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Marsh Elder, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its therapeutic properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic actions, making it beneficial for wound healing and skin issues. The Narrow-leaved Marsh Elder plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects. The health benefits of this plant include reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and promoting antioxidant activity, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
